title: Leaf versus flower: green-synthesized silver nanoparticles from Xanthoceras sorbifolia leaf extract reveal superior antimicrobial and cytotoxic efficacy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23654-23669
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02434J, Paper
Open Access

Yongqiang Han, Renchi Fu, Yanyang Dai, Chao Tan, Wenjie Wang, Dongdong Guo, Zhongling Ma, Xiaojun Zhang
Green-synthesized AgNPs from Xanthoceras sorbifolia leaf extract demonstrate superior antimicrobial and cytotoxic efficacy against cancer cells compared with flower-derived nanoparticles, suggesting enhanced biomedical application potential.
